summary: Tested iteration-106 (min_price hard floor + /cart/quote + individual discount on all payment methods + payment adjustments editable in «Скидки и акции» admin tab). Backend: new pytest file tests/test_iter106_floor_individual_discount.py — 13/13 pass. Regression (test_promo_codes.py + test_promo_fixes_iter104.py) 28/28 pass. Key verifications: GET /api/cart/quote?payment_method=cash with product price=1000 min_price=950 qty=2 returns goods_total=1900, sum_floors=1900, items[0].price=950 — i.e. exactly what POST /orders charges. card path yields 2200, crypto/none paths also correct. Orders are ALWAYS created 200: cash at floor keeps item price=950 and individual_discount_amount=0 (no room above floor); card path applies individual 10% (1100 -> 990 per unit, above floor) and persists individual_discount_percent=10 / individual_discount_amount=110. Individual discount now applies across card, cash, balance (pay_with_balance), deferral AND mixed (card+cash, payment_parts sum equals order.total). Promo code with 50% at floor: order still placed; goods ≥ sum of floors. Admin payment-settings PUT /api/admin/payment-settings persists cash_adjustment change and preserves card_enabled / deferred_payment_enabled / deferred_payment_hours / other adjustments. Frontend: /admin → «Скидки и акции» → discounts-subtab-payment shows payment-adjustments-section with payment-adjustment-input-{card,cash,crypto,balance} (values 10/-10/-15/0), payment-adjustment-label-{key}, payment-adjustments-save-btn. In 'Платежи' tab the percent inputs are replaced by read-only text ('+10%','-10%','-15%','0%') with hint «Наценка/Скидка — меняется во вкладке «Скидки и акции»»; the enable switches still work. /cart (user@demo.com, individual_discount 10) with TEST product price=1000 min_price=950 qty=2: payment-method-cash -> checkout-total=1 900 ₽ (matches server quote & actual order), checkout-individual-discount-line hidden (floor reached, 0 room), checkout-cart-discount-line shows reduced real -100 ₽ (not -200); payment-method-card -> checkout-total=1 980 ₽, checkout-individual-discount-line visible '−220 ₽' confirming the individual discount now applies on card too. Floor + individual + payment-method semantics match end-to-end between product page clamp, cart UI, /cart/quote and POST /orders.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py is 1629 lines; _price_cart_lines + create_order mixed/single branches share floor-clamp + individual-discount logic that could be unified into a single helper (target, floors) -> (target_after_ind, ind_amount).
In orders.py line 447 the inline comment still says 'ONLY when paying from balance' but the actual code now applies the individual discount on every method — stale comment, worth updating.

GET /cart/quote silently returns 0s for an empty cart (no 404). That is fine, but it also does not validate payment_method (any arbitrary string yields adjustment=0). Could 400 on unknown method for defensive clarity.
Frontend CartPage.js re-queries /cart/quote on every payment-method/toggle change — consider debouncing to avoid a burst when user clicks through several methods.
